description: Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports - Sports Law No.25 of 1973 - Regulations Made by the Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports Under the Section 32 and 33 of Sports Law No.25 of 1973.
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports under Sections 32 and 33 of the Sports Law, No. 25 of 1973. It involves legal/regulatory actions including suspending registration of Sri Lanka Rugby, revoking and making appointments, and establishing a working task force - all based on statutory authority. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it deals with regulatory frameworks, statutory instruments, and legal amendments under existing sports legislation.
